theme_and_archetype.vibe: Professional, sleek, Scandinavian minimalism. 'Dark but not too dark'.

typography.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Keep headings font-light or font-normal to maintain the sleek Scandinavian look. Use uppercase + wide tracking for subheadings/labels.

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: The 'Tetris' Grid (Mode A) for marketing sections, allowing asymmetrical, wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12).
spacing_and_layout.header: Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#1A1A1A]/70) with 1px delicate inner stroke (border-white/10). Z-index 50.

navigation.description: Sticky header with crystal glassmorphism. Contains Logo, standard links, and a Language Toggle (NO/EN) pill.
navigation.language_toggle: Default to Norwegian (NO). Sleek toggle button.

hero.description: High visual impact hero. Use the generated abstract background as a subtle underlying texture (bg-cover, max opacity 20%). Large typography, strong value proposition.
hero.layout: Asymmetric, text heavy on the left, empty breathing space on the right.

services.layout: Grid Borders ('Technical' Look) - border-collapse style layout, items have subtle borders on right and bottom. No Shadcn Cards, use raw HTML/Tailwind.

portfolio.interactions: The 2 provided videos MUST auto-play when they enter the viewport (use IntersectionObserver or framer-motion useInView). Muted, looping.
portfolio.layout: Massive, immersive layout. Videos shouldn't be constrained to tiny boxes. Use negative space.

about_us.layout: Image on one side, text on the other. High contrast typography.

fields: What they are looking for (Hva ser du etter) - textarea

footer.content: Must include Org. number: 937 733 615. Large typography for 'Nettekspertene'.

hero_background.description: Abstract 3D dark slate geometric texture, perfect for the hero background with low opacity.

about_us_image.description: Minimalist desk setup with natural elements, used to represent the studio in the About Us section.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth scrolling. Momentum and weight make the site feel premium.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Explicitly set text color on hover. Use a slightly lighter surface color (e.g., hover:bg-[#3A3A3A]).
motion_and_interactions.videos: Crucial: Scroll-triggered video playback. The videos must be paused by default and play only when visible to save resources and create a 'living' feel.

testing.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Use React + Tailwind + Vite. Install framer-motion, lucide-react, lenis, @radix-ui/react-icons.
instructions_to_main_agent.language: Implement a simple React context or state for i18n (Norwegian and English). Default NO.
instructions_to_main_agent.email: Implement Resend logic for the contact form.
instructions_to_main_agent.styling: Enforce the dark theme strictly by making the body bg-[#1A1A1A] and text-[#F5F5F5]. Avoid pure black.
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn: Customize shadcn components (Input, Select, Form, Textarea) to match the high-end dark theme (no heavy borders, use background colors with subtle outlines).
